thread:
Nina: quick heads-up — after last night's RBAC role-inheritance refactor landed, we are seeing /v1/embeddings accept tokens that only have chat:model scopes when a key was recently rewrapped by KMS.
Sam: hmm — do you have a repro or logs?
Nina: yes, repro from prod-1. Example: client used a chat-only token for embeddings and the call succeeded. I pulled the authz logs: authz decision = ALLOW, reason = inherited-role:default-service-role. No per-route check triggered.
Kevin: that sounds like the new inheritance path is evaluated before route-specific allowlists. We added inheritance to simplify role mappings — maybe order got reversed.
Maria: rotation context matter? you mentioned rewrap by KMS.
Nina: yes — interesting part: after a rewrap, token metadata lookup returns without key_id in some cached entries. Authz fallback uses service-account-role which has broad fallback to chat+embeddings. So combination: missing key_id -> fallback role -> inheritance checks pass -> embeddings allowed.
Sam: can you paste the authz log snippet?
Nina: pasted snippet:
```
authz: request_id=01F3XZ3 audit_id=78c host=prod-1 route=/v1/embeddings token_id=tok-9ab meta={scope:chat:model, key_tag:<redacted>} decision=ALLOW via=inherited(default-service-role) note="metadata.key_id=null"
```
Kevin: that note is the giveaway. key_id null shouldn't cause broad fallback. We intended explicit deny if metadata lookup failed. Looks like the refactor introduced a permissive default.
rotations-bot: KMS rewrap completed for key=projects/prod/keys/k-42 at 2025-06-12T01:03:07Z
Maria: mitigation? we should patch fast.
Sam: immediate steps: 1) add a temporary deny rule in the auth proxy for /v1/embeddings that requires explicit embeddings scope; 2) revert the permissive default in authz; 3) add audit log enrichment to persist pre-rewrap key_tag and key_id if present.
Nina: agree. I've opened a WAF rule ticket to block embeddings if token scope != embeddings. WAF PR id: #1247 (hotpatch).
Kevin: I'll draft a minimal authz hotfix to prefer route-allowlist before inheritance and to treat missing metadata as DENY. Can we push a canary to prod-1?
Sam: yes — canary window 15m then promote. I'll own deploy and rollback plan.
Maria: also add a quick query to the audit store to find all calls in the last 48h where route=/v1/embeddings and token_scope contains "chat:" but decision=ALLOW. We need incident impact assessment.
Nina: running the query now — will post counts in a sec.
Nina: quick count: ~42 successful embeddings calls matching that pattern across 3 customers, most within the 4h window after the rewrap.
Sam: ok that's non-trivial. Notify CS and legal?
Maria: yes, I pinged CS. We should prepare a customer-facing statement only if we confirm data exposure. For now treat as potential exposure.
Kevin: timeline + root cause to include in postmortem: RBAC inheritance reorder + metadata loss after KMS rewrap + permissive default behavior.
Nina: postmortem draft assigned to me. Sam and Kevin to co-own remediation PRs. Maria to lead impact assessment and comms.
rotations-bot: scheduled rewraps in next 24h: k-42, k-17.
Sam: we should pause automated rewraps until fix is validated. Maria, can you pause the scheduled job?
Maria: paused job and added a hold note.
Nina: summary of immediate action items: - WAF hotpatch for /v1/embeddings (Nina) - Authz hotfix to DENY on missing key_id and prefer route allowlist (Kevin) - Deploy canary + rollback plan (Sam) - Audit query + customer impact list (Maria) - Pause scheduled rewraps (Maria) - Postmortem + timeline (Nina)
Kevin: I'll open the PR with test cases for missing metadata and route precedence.
Sam: deploying WAF hotpatch now. I'll alert infra if latency spike.
Nina: thanks. Please post updates here as they happen.
Maria: update — audit query now has customer ids and request ids, sending to CS privately.
Sam: canary deployed to prod-1, 15m monitoring window started.
Nina: canary looks clean so far (no new chat->embeddings allows).
Kevin: merged authz hotfix to canary, rolling to prod-1 after 5m.
Sam: hotfix live on prod-1. Doing smoke tests.
Nina: smoke tests pass. Embeddings now rejected for chat-only tokens.
Maria: resuming scheduled rewraps with a hold policy and additional metadata preservation flag.
Nina: closing loop: incident severity P2, postmortem assigned, owners set. We'll follow up with a timeline and lessons learned.
Sam: thanks team :thumbsup:
